clips.title: The story
paras: Orders from Kadrak reach Warsong Scout Update as scouts watch the contested woods. The Horde depends on their reports to guard its positions in Ashenvale against night elf attacks.

Kadrak depends on scattered Warsong scouts to watch the Ashenvale border. The forest gives night elf sentinels cover, and the scouts face the risk of being cut off. Couriers carry written updates between them so isolated outposts can report what they see and remain connected to Horde command.

Warsong scouts watch for night elf raids meant to reclaim the forest. Every stretch of Ashenvale the clan has cleared or occupied has cost lives. Kadrak's orders keep the forward scouts in touch with the Horde and give them a way to report that their defenses are holding against elven resistance.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Keep an eye out, traveler. The elves are often hiding in the shadows...
We must always be watching. We have worked very hard to claim this land, and the elves are looking for a chance to take it from us.
I assume you have my next orders from Kadrak?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Let Kadrak know of the success we have had here holding off the night elves. Our plans are going well.
